provenance.origin: User-pasted A5 terminal output; local independent arithmetic and comparison with prior local CPU quality results

execution.quality: All50 natural queries in two Q25 packets; one checked round
execution.performance: Seeded16 natural queries, two Q8 packets, six forward/reverse rounds, five warmup cycles and thirty samples/case/process; original native 1/8/32 worker comparison
execution.timer: Complete steady-state raw-ID Search to CPU Top-K; excludes construction, JIT/first upload/warmup and diagnostics

quality_interpretation.scope: A5 aggregate metrics exactly reproduce prior C++ strict and original-native CPU results. Prior local full-score strict IDs matched the project and native selected-score multisets matched the same oracle, with native tie ID differences. This supports the known tie-policy explanation, not a new GPU ranking-quality improvement; A5 per-query rankings were not independently received.

validation.correctness: Final quality/performance output follows the independent score/strict-ID/tree/guard/repeat checks in the expected driver. Raw device outputs were not downloaded separately.
validation.timing_limit: Fastest-worker choices are supplied by the driver; individual-worker timing reports were not received for independent re-selection. Means/raw samples are absent, so no actual aggregate QPS is inferred from medians.

assessment.quality: Device/host checks completed and quality matches the independent strict CPU reference; native tie policy retained
assessment.performance: Both A/B timing gates passed; latency ratios 1.40685/1.40808, reductions 28.92%/28.98%
assessment.scope: Full quality covers50 queries; Q8 performance covers the fixed16-query sample. This real 171332-document dataset differs from SciFact and the 10M synthetic corpus, so the cross-dataset ratios are not a controlled scale-only experiment or universal business speed guarantee.
assessment.production_policy: Keep the current production structure, operators and hardening; no performance-driven policy removal is required by these measurements.
